reviewer_role: Independent adversarial final recheck; root is author
verdict: accept all 16 actual final canonical values
fresh_read_scope: All 16 final English→Marathi values actually read from the canonical source/target files and checked against selected final targets and actual statistics/terrain context. No full new reread of unchanged catalogs is claimed.

entries.rationale: आढावा naturally names the summary tab.
अर्थव्यवस्था covers the work/material/building economy topic.
जग retains the world/environment category without narrowing it to terrain alone.
काम आणि बांधकाम retains both coordinated activities and reads grammatically.
संरक्षण matches the warriors/intruders context and existing Marathi defence terms.
इतिहास पहा is an action and matches the existing independently reviewed [view history] wording.
आकडेवारीची प्रतीक्षा… is a short impersonal waiting-for-data status with the authored ellipsis.

युनिटचे तपशील is accepted as a generic category heading using the established uninflected loan युनिट. The details list plainly covers unit totals/types; it introduces no explicit claim that only one selected unit is shown. My earlier plural-s wording was a stylistic preference, not a remaining concrete defect.
नकाशावरील आच्छादने supplies the correct locative relationship and established overlay term.
विषय is a natural reusable Topic label.
संपूर्ण इतिहास उघडा accurately instructs opening the full history dialog.

entries.source: — No recorded reading yet. Select a statistic for details.
entries.actual_final_target: — अद्याप मोजमापाची नोंद नाही. तपशील पाहण्यासाठी आकडेवारीतील एखादा घटक निवडा.
entries.rationale: मोजमापाची नोंद identifies a missing recorded reading. आकडेवारीतील एखादा घटक makes selection of a single statistic explicit; negation, yet/अद्याप and the details action are preserved.
हिरवेगार गवत is an idiomatic lush-grass terrain label with neuter agreement.
कोरडे गवत uses a neutral dry adjective agreeing with neuter गवत; it does not invent a distinct dried resource.
वाळूच्या टेकड्यांतील वाळू preserves dune-associated sand as the material/terrain head noun.
फिकट वाळू retains the pale colour distinction from dune sand.

unchanged_carry.scope: 3393 original native + previous 2 actual reviewed additions and all online values retain their prior honest review chain through exact value/byte equality; not freshly reread.

limits: Text/context signoff only. Fresh current producer matrix/UI rendering is still required after the overlapping font/renderer integration.
No native macOS/Windows/iOS runtime claim; no physical-phone claim from desktop compact captures.
